graphql.document:
query LinearIssues($first: Int!, $after: String) { issues(after: $after, first: $first) { nodes {
      __typename
      id
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      archivedAt
      title
      number
      identifier
      url
      description
    } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
